form.domainHelp: Leave blank for the zone apex; enter www for www.{zone}.
form.typeHelp: Switching the type adjusts the data fields below automatically.
form.ttlHelp: Leave blank or enter 0 to use the server default of {default} seconds.
form.commentsHelp: For console display only; not included in DNS responses.
form.expiryTtlHelp: Record is auto-deleted after expiry; enter 0 for no expiry.
form.overwrite: Overwrite existing record with same name and type
form.overwriteHelp: When enabled, duplicates replace the old record instead of causing an error.
form.identityHint: Fields above identify the record to modify; enter updated values below.
form.soaSingleHint: SOA, CNAME, and DNAME allow only one record per name; editing replaces it directly.
form.requiredMissing: Please fill in all required fields
form.glueHint: A/AAAA glue records attached to this NS record.
form.rawHint: Below is the raw rData JSON returned by the server, for troubleshooting.

A.label: A
A.hint: Maps a domain name to an IPv4 address

AAAA.label: AAAA
AAAA.hint: Maps a domain name to an IPv6 address

NS.label: NS
NS.hint: Authoritative name server for a delegated zone

SOA.label: SOA
SOA.hint: Start of authority; one per zone

CNAME.label: CNAME
CNAME.hint: Alias pointing to another domain name

PTR.label: PTR
PTR.hint: Reverse lookup from IP to domain name

TXT.label: TXT
TXT.hint: Arbitrary text; commonly used for SPF/DKIM/domain verification

RP.label: RP
RP.hint: Responsible person mailbox and text record

SRV.label: SRV
SRV.hint: Service locator with priority, weight, and port

NAPTR.label: NAPTR
NAPTR.hint: Naming authority pointer; often used for ENUM telephone routing

DS.label: DS
DS.hint: Delegation signer for the DNSSEC chain of trust

ANAME.label: ANAME
ANAME.hint: Apex alias; resolves to address records

FWD.label: FWD
FWD.hint: Conditional forwarding record; forwards queries to a designated resolver

APP.label: APP
APP.hint: DNS application record; handled by an installed app

SVCB.label: SVCB
SVCB.hint: Service binding record (RFC 9460) describing connection parameters for a service

HTTPS.label: HTTPS
HTTPS.hint: HTTPS-specific form of SVCB, letting clients optimize connection and encryption

Unknown.label: Unknown
Unknown.hint: Unknown type; edited as raw RDATA

fields.updateSvcbHints: Update address hints for SVCB/HTTPS records

empty.title: No records for this name
empty.body: Add the first record, or switch to another name.
empty.noZoneRecords: This zone has no records yet.
empty.hint: Note: a newly created Primary zone automatically includes SOA and NS records.

soa.title: SOA record
soa.serialHelp: The serial must increment after each change; secondaries use it to determine whether a sync is needed.

glue.title: Glue records
glue.hint: When an NS record points to a name within this zone, matching address records are required to avoid resolution loops.
